offering_title: Claude Code Meeting Summarizer Setup for Teams
one_sentence_pitch: I build and deploy a working AI meeting summarizer in your existing tools so your team stops losing decisions and action items in Zoom recordings.
exact_deliverable: A deployed Claude Code agent that ingests meeting transcripts (via Zoom/Otter/manual paste), extracts decisions, action items, and owners, and posts a formatted summary to Slack or Notion — tested with 5 real meetings from the client's team.

buyer_persona.job_title: Head of Operations or Chief of Staff
buyer_persona.pain_point: Meetings produce no reliable record of who owns what; follow-through dies in Slack threads and forgotten Zoom recordings

finding_buyers.outreach_channel: LinkedIn DM to Heads of Ops at Series A–B SaaS companies, referencing the 2 existing users of the tool

pricing.pricing_rationale: Buyer saves 2–5 hrs/week of manual note-taking across a team — at $2500 the ROI is immediate

sample_proposal: Hi Sarah — I noticed Acme is hiring an ops coordinator, which usually means meetings are outpacing your team's ability to track decisions. I recently built a meeting summarizer using Claude Code for two former colleagues at Series B SaaS companies — it pulls action items, owners, and key decisions from any transcript and posts them directly to Notion within 60 seconds of the meeting ending. I can build and deploy the same thing for your team in under a week, tuned to how your meetings actually run. Fixed fee, no ongoing subscription, and I'll train whoever owns it on day one. Happy to show you a live demo — 20 minutes, no deck.
first_client_strategy: Message both ex-colleagues who already use the summarizer and ask for one warm intro to their Head of Ops or a peer at another company. Offer a $500 pilot price to the first referral client in exchange for a written testimonial.

offering_title: AI-Powered Email Triage Agent for Ops Teams

exact_deliverable: A working email triage agent connected to Gmail or Outlook via API: categorizes incoming ops emails into 5–8 custom labels, drafts context-aware replies for the 3 most common request types, and flags urgent items to Slack. Delivered with documentation and a 1-hour handoff call.
